Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Hurst
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 442 as introduced would require all forms of payment, including cash, to be accepted by a public K-12 school or local board of education for admission to school-sponsored sporting events. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Terri Collins, Chair
Education Policy

Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Hurst
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 04/05/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 442 as passed the House of Representatives would require cash, along with any other form of payment of its choosing, to be accepted by a public K-12 school or local board of education for admission to school-sponsored sporting events. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Tim Melson, Chairperson
Education Policy
